Specification: This specification models a simple spanning-tree construction protocol over a fixed directed neighbor relation on a set of processes. Initially every process has no parent, no process has reported, and no sent-message flag is set; processes can send discovery messages along edges, adopt a parent when they receive a message while parentless and not the root, and later mark themselves as reported. The spec defines a temporal behavior with weak fairness on the main next-state action, and it asserts typing, an eventual spanning-tree property, an invariant-like one-parent stability property, and a predicate constraining when parentless non-root processes may have sent messages.
IfThenElse: IF i # root /\ parent[i] = NULL /\ sntMsg[j][i] THEN Update(i, j) ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i) \/ UNCHANGED <<parent, sntMsg, reported>>
TemporalSubscript:
WF_vars(\E i, j \in Proc: IF i # root /\ parent[i] = NULL /\ sntMsg[j][i]
                          THEN Update(i, j)
                          ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i)
                               \/ UNCHANGED <<parent, sntMsg, reported>>)
[][\A i \in Proc : parent[i] # NULL => parent[i] = parent'[i]]_vars
AlwaysOp: [][\A i \in Proc : parent[i] # NULL => parent[i] = parent'[i]]_vars
EventuallyOp: <>(\A i \in Proc : i = root \/ (parent[i] # NULL /\ nbrs[i][parent[i]]))
FairnessConditions:
WF_vars(\E i, j \in Proc: IF i # root /\ parent[i] = NULL /\ sntMsg[j][i]
                          THEN Update(i, j)
                          ELSE \/ Send(i) \/ Parent(i)
                               \/ UNCHANGED <<parent, sntMsg, reported>>)
